messages:
bryan_csm: Quick heads-up — Borealis Insurance (renewal in Q3) opened a request to onboard a customer-finetuned claims summarization model. They want private deployment + PHI controls. Asking for ETA and safety eval plan.

maria_success_engineer: Thanks Bryan. Do we have model artifact format from them? HF or torchscript? Any size/FP32 vs quantized notes?

bryan_csm: They sent a tarball, says tokenizer + model in HF format, ~8.3GB. It's a fine-tuned Llama2-13b variant. Requested throughput ~20 r/s peak, low latency for support UI.

aj_devex: OK — private deployment makes sense. We'll need KMS integration, audit logging, and a policy for PII/PHI redaction. I can draft an enablement playbook for the CS engineer and their infra team.

kaela_research: On the safety side, we should run our standard safety evals + a bespoke PHI leakage test. Can we get a small labeled prompt set from them for recall/precision on key PII entities? Also want to run toxicity/regulatory prompts.

simon_infra: Capacity note: 13B v2 at 8.3GB likely quantizable to int8, fits on a single A10x or T4? For 20 r/s and low latency we should plan for 2x replicas behind LB and autoscale headroom. Also confirm whether they want Dedicated pool or Private VPC — billing impacts renewal.

bryan_csm: They prefer Private VPC for compliance. Renewal risk flagged: they said SLA and predictable latency are dealbreakers. If onboarding goes slow we might lose or renegotiate.

maria_success_engineer: Action items: 1) AJ to produce enablement doc + onboarding checklist; 2) Kaela to define eval suite and required sample prompts; 3) Simon to propose infra sizing and infra estimate; 4) Bryan to collect customer artifact + signed DPA.

aj_devex: Will do. Draft ETA: enablement doc + checklist by EOD tomorrow. Also will include sample config snippets. e.g.:
```
model: borealis-claims-v1
deploy_mode: private_vpc
gpus: a10x-2
replicas: 2
kms: customer-kms-key
logging: audit=true
```

kaela_research: I'll spin up safety evals next week. Need ~200 labeled prompts for PHI checks. Can we ask customer for those? Also recommend a rollout canary: start 5% traffic for 48h with QC metrics.

simon_infra: I'll put together an infra sketch + cost delta (Dedicated vs Private). Quick q: do they require on-prem package or cloud VPC?

bryan_csm: They want cloud VPC with strict egress rules. I'll request the labeled prompts and DPA now.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4821 "Borealis claims model onboarding" assigned to maria_success_engineer, kaela_research, aj_devex, simon_infra. ETA fields pending.

maria_success_engineer: Great, I'll sync with them tomorrow 10am PST and start the enablement checklist. Bryan — can you drop the contact and artifact link here? :point_down:

bryan_csm: Dropped link in the customer portal and DM'd the artifact to you. Also flagged renewal manager to monitor. :eyes:

aj_devex: Noted. I'll attach the playbook to the ticket when ready. :thumbsup:

kaela_research: Added a preliminary eval plan to the ticket — will update after we get the sample prompts.

bryan_csm: Thanks all — let's avoid any delays on the labeled prompts to reduce renewal risk.
